2015.question: Read carefully the stanza given below and answer the questions that follow :
2015.prashna: नीचे दिए गए छंद को ध्यान से पढ़िए और निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए :
2015.context: "Once ... once upon a time ... ." Over and over again, Martha would tell us her stories, In the hazel glen.

sub_questions.1: From which poem have these lines been extracted ?
sub_questions.2: How does Martha begin her stories ?
sub_questions.3: Where does Martha tell her stories ?

anuprashna.1: ये पंक्तियाँ किस कविता से ली गई हैं?
anuprashna.2: मार्था अपनी कहानियाँ कैसे शुरू करती है?
anuprashna.3: मार्था अपनी कहानियाँ कहाँ सुनाती है?

2015.question: Read carefully the stanza given below and answer the questions that follow:
2015.prashna: नीचे दिए गए पद्यांश को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़ें और उसके बाद आने वाले प्रश्नों के उत्तर दें:
2015.context:
"Once………..once upon a time........”.
Over and over again,
Martha would tell us her stories,
In the hazel glen.

sub_questions.2: How does Martha begin her stories?
sub_questions.3: Where does Martha tell her stories?
